title: Kitchen meal-template v1
description: The kitchen module's published meal-template interface (specs/modules/kitchen.md § Meal-bank sheet consumption). Any gitsheet satisfying this contract can back the module's meal-bank read — a sheet-sourced recipe projection. Self-contained, no external $ref. TOML data model: no null-bearing keywords (no 'null' type, no 'nullable'); an unknown field is simply absent, never null. Deliberately open (no additionalProperties: false anywhere) so producers can carry extra fields the module doesn't read yet.

calories.description: Flat single-item calorie count, when this record isn't broken into components.

protein_g.description: Flat single-item protein (grams), paired with calories.

sat_fat_g.description: Flat single-item saturated fat (grams), paired with calories.

sodium_mg.description: Flat single-item sodium (milligrams), paired with calories.

components.description: Per-ingredient breakdown, when this record is a multi-component recipe rather than a single flat item. When present, the module computes macros deterministically from components × logged quantities rather than the flat calorie fields above.

default_qty_g.description: Default quantity in grams, used when a logged entry doesn't specify its own quantity for this component.

sat_fat_g.description: Saturated fat (grams) per 100g of this ingredient.

provenance.description: Where this record's numbers came from (e.g. a label photo, a nutrition database lookup, a recipe calculator) — informational, not machine-checked.
